parameters.content:
## Worker Dashboard API v1

POST-only JSON API for the worker dashboard. Actions: login (Michelle), leads (list w/ profile + draft status), draft (fetch one), save (edit subject/body, marks approved), send (SMTP send + mark sent).

Auth: session token issued on login, required on every other action. Send requires the KQuality Gmail SMTP credential to be configured in n8n (Gmail app password). If SMTP fails, the draft is NOT marked sent.

Read/write scope: leads.outreach_drafts only (plus read of candidates/segments).

parameters.query: WITH login_attempt AS (SELECT u.name FROM leads.dashboard_users u WHERE $1 = 'login' AND u.name = $2 AND u.password_hash = encode(digest($3 || u.salt, 'sha256'), 'hex')), new_session AS (INSERT INTO leads.dashboard_sessions (token, user_name, expires_at) SELECT encode(digest(gen_random_uuid()::text || clock_timestamp()::text, 'sha256'), 'hex'), name, now() + interval '7 days' FROM login_attempt RETURNING token, user_name), valid_session AS (SELECT s.user_name FROM leads.dashboard_sessions s WHERE $1 <> 'login' AND s.token = $4 AND s.expires_at > now()) SELECT COALESCE((SELECT user_name FROM new_session), (SELECT user_name FROM valid_session)) AS auth_user, (SELECT token FROM new_session) AS new_token
INSERT INTO leads.crm_records (candidate_id, owner, added_by, source) VALUES ($1::bigint, $2, $2, 'manual') ON CONFLICT (candidate_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id

SELECT r.candidate_id, r.status, r.stage, r.owner, r.last_contact_at, r.next_action, r.next_action_due, r.notes, r.notes_updated_at, r.source, r.added_by, r.added_at,
  c.business_name, c.address, c.suburb, c.phone, c.email, c.website, c.linkedin_url, c.qualification_score, s.name AS segment,
  d.sent_at, d.followup_count, d.last_followup_at,
  (CASE WHEN d.status = 'sent' AND r.stage = 'contacted' AND r.status = 'active' AND d.followup_count < 3 THEN (CASE d.followup_count WHEN 0 THEN d.sent_at + interval '3 days' WHEN 1 THEN d.last_followup_at + interval '5 days' WHEN 2 THEN d.last_followup_at + interval '7 days' END) END) AS next_followup_at,
  lr.received_at AS last_reply_at, lr.subject AS last_reply_subject, lr.snippet AS last_reply_snippet
FROM leads.crm_records r
JOIN leads.candidates c ON c.id = r.candidate_id
LEFT JOIN leads.segments s ON s.id = c.segment_id
LEFT JOIN leads.outreach_drafts d ON d.candidate_id = r.candidate_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT received_at, subject, left(body_text,240) AS snippet FROM leads.inbound_replies ir WHERE ir.candidate_id = r.candidate_id ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1
) lr ON true
ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC

WITH old AS (
  SELECT stage AS old_stage FROM leads.crm_records WHERE candidate_id = $1::bigint
),
u AS (
  UPDATE leads.crm_records SET stage = $2, status = CASE WHEN $2 = 'won' THEN 'won' WHEN $2 = 'lost' THEN 'lost' ELSE status END, last_contact_at = CASE WHEN $2 IN ('replied','meeting') THEN now() ELSE last_contact_at END, updated_at = now()
  WHERE candidate_id = $1::bigint AND $2 IN ('new','contacted','replied','meeting','quote_sent','negotiation','won','lost')
  RETURNING stage
),
h AS (
  INSERT INTO leads.crm_stage_history (candidate_id, stage, changed_by)
  SELECT $1::bigint, u.stage, $3 FROM u, old WHERE old.old_stage IS DISTINCT FROM u.stage
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT stage FROM u), 'invalid') AS stage

parameters.jsCode: return { json: { out: JSON.stringify({ ok: $json.stage !== 'invalid', stage: $json.stage }) } };

SELECT candidate_id, kind, subject, snippet, ts, counterparty FROM (
  SELECT c.id AS candidate_id, 'discovered' AS kind, NULL::text AS subject, NULL::text AS snippet, c.discovered_at AS ts, NULL::text AS counterparty FROM leads.candidates c WHERE c.id = $1::bigint
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.id, 'qualified', NULL, ('Score ' || c.qualification_score::text), c.qualified_at, NULL FROM leads.candidates c WHERE c.id = $1::bigint AND c.qualified_at IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT candidate_id, 'sent', subject, left(body,300), sent_at, sent_to FROM leads.outreach_drafts WHERE candidate_id = $1::bigint AND status = 'sent'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT candidate_id, 'followup', subject, left(body,300), sent_at, sent_to FROM leads.outreach_followups WHERE candidate_id = $1::bigint
  UNION ALL
  SELECT candidate_id, 'reply', subject, left(body_text,300), received_at, sender FROM leads.inbound_replies WHERE candidate_id = $1::bigint
  UNION ALL
  SELECT candidate_id, 'stage_change', NULL, stage, changed_at, changed_by FROM leads.crm_stage_history WHERE candidate_id = $1::bigint
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.candidate_id, 'notes', NULL, left(r.notes,300), r.notes_updated_at, r.added_by FROM leads.crm_records r WHERE r.candidate_id = $1::bigint AND r.notes_updated_at IS NOT NULL AND length(r.notes) > 0
) t ORDER BY ts ASC

parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(x), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT w.name, w.active,
      le.status AS last_status, le."startedAt" AS last_started_at, le."stoppedAt" AS last_stopped_at,
      ls."stoppedAt" AS last_success_at,
      lf."stoppedAt" AS last_failed_at
    FROM workflow_entity w
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT status, "startedAt", "stoppedAt" FROM execution_entity e WHERE e."workflowId" = w.id AND e."deletedAt" IS NULL ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 1) le ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "stoppedAt" FROM execution_entity e WHERE e."workflowId" = w.id AND e.status = 'success' AND e."deletedAt" IS NULL ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 1) ls ON true
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "stoppedAt" FROM execution_entity e WHERE e."workflowId" = w.id AND e.status IN ('error','crashed') AND e."deletedAt" IS NULL ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 1) lf ON true
    WHERE w.name = ANY($1::text[]) AND w."isArchived" = false
    ORDER BY w.name
  ) x) AS workflows,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads.inbound_replies) AS replies_total,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads.inbound_replies WHERE received_at::date = now()::date) AS replies_today,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads.inbound_replies WHERE candidate_id IS NULL) AS replies_unmatched,
  (SELECT max(received_at) FROM leads.inbound_replies) AS last_reply_at,
  (SELECT max(x) FROM (SELECT max(sent_at) AS x FROM leads.outreach_drafts WHERE status='sent' UNION ALL SELECT max(sent_at) FROM leads.outreach_followups) s) AS last_smtp_send_at

parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads.candidates WHERE duplicate_of IS NULL) AS leads_discovered,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads.candidates WHERE duplicate_of IS NULL AND enriched_at IS NOT NULL) AS leads_enriched,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads.candidates WHERE duplicate_of IS NULL AND stage='qualified' AND qualification_score>=80) AS qualified_hot,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads.candidates WHERE duplicate_of IS NULL AND stage='qualified' AND qualification_score>=55 AND qualification_score<80) AS qualified_warm,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads.candidates WHERE duplicate_of IS NULL AND stage='qualified' AND (qualification_score<55 OR qualification_score IS NULL)) AS qualified_cold,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads.outreach_drafts) AS drafts_generated,
  ((SELECT count(*) FROM leads.outreach_drafts WHERE status='sent') + (SELECT count(*) FROM leads.outreach_followups)) AS emails_sent,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads.inbound_replies WHERE candidate_id IS NOT NULL) AS replies_received,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads.crm_records WHERE stage='contacted' AND status='active') AS active_followups,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads.crm_records WHERE stage='meeting') AS meetings_booked,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads.crm_records WHERE stage='won') AS won,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads.crm_records) AS crm_total,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads.outreach_drafts WHERE sent_by='daily_auto_engine' AND sent_at::date = now()::date) AS daily_auto_sent_today,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads.outreach_drafts WHERE sent_by='daily_auto_engine') AS daily_auto_sent_total

SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.ts ASC), '[]'::json) AS rows FROM (
  SELECT r.id, 'inbound'::text AS direction, r.subject, r.body_text, r.sender AS counterparty, r.received_at AS ts, r.message_id
  FROM leads.inbound_replies r WHERE r.candidate_id = $1::bigint
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.id, 'outbound', d.subject, d.body, d.sent_to, d.sent_at, d.message_id
  FROM leads.outreach_drafts d WHERE d.candidate_id = $1::bigint AND d.status = 'sent'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT f.id, 'outbound', f.subject, f.body, f.sent_to, f.sent_at, f.message_id
  FROM leads.outreach_followups f WHERE f.candidate_id = $1::bigint
) t

SELECT c.id AS candidate_id, c.business_name,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(r.sender, ''), c.email) AS to_email,
  r.message_id AS in_reply_to,
  r.subject AS reply_subject
FROM leads.candidates c
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT sender, message_id, subject FROM leads.inbound_replies
  WHERE candidate_id = c.id AND ($2::bigint = 0 OR id = $2::bigint)
  ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1
) r ON true
WHERE c.id = $1::bigint

WITH f AS (
  INSERT INTO leads.outreach_followups (candidate_id, followup_no, subject, body, sent_to, message_id)
  SELECT $1::bigint, COALESCE((SELECT max(followup_no) FROM leads.outreach_followups WHERE candidate_id = $1::bigint), 0) + 1, $2, $3, $4, $5
  RETURNING candidate_id
)
UPDATE leads.crm_records SET last_contact_at = now(), updated_at = now(),
  stage = CASE WHEN stage IN ('new','contacted') THEN 'replied' ELSE stage END
WHERE candidate_id IN (SELECT candidate_id FROM f)
